# Ideal Findings Catalog — 29:38 Macro Scope

**Purpose:** Independent benchmark for evaluating Luna's macro discovery on 29:38.
**Generated by:** Claude Opus analysis of the hermetic lane packet evidence.
**Date:** 2026-09-09

## Focus Ayah

وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ

"Âd ve Semûd'u da yok ettik. Bu, yurtlarından size açıkça belli olmuştur. Şeytan
onlara yaptıklarını güzel gösterdi ve anlayabilecek durumda oldukları halde onları
yoldan alıkoydu."

## Finding 1: Road Obstruction Chain

**Origin candidate:** Cutting the Worked Road (cand_df9c356, channel, trusted)
**Claim:** 29:29's highway robbery of Lot's people (تَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ — "you cut
the road") reframes 29:38's فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ from abstract spiritual
blocking into a pattern of physical road-cutting repeated across destroyed
communities. The "worked road" sense of أَعْمَال intensifies this: what Satan
beautified was not merely "deeds" but the very public route they exploited.

**Ideal branch activations (7):**

| Branch | Registry | Carrier | Trigger | Difficulty |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|------------|
| root_000672/B001 (path) | focus | السَّبِيلِ 29:38 | 29:29 السَّبِيلَ | trivial |
| root_000848/B001 (obstruction) | focus | صَدَّ 29:38 | 29:29's تَقْطَعُونَ | trivial |
| root_001046/B011 (worked road) | focus | أَعْمَالَ 29:38 | 29:29 road as "worked track" | medium |
| root_001240/B023 (road robbery) | nominated | 29:29 قَطْع | focus صَدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيل | easy |
| root_000672/B002 (traveler) | focus | السَّبِيلِ implies user | 29:29's explicit travelers | easy |
| root_000848/B004 (watering path) | focus | صَدَّ as "path to water" | 29:29 road-cutting imagery | medium |
| root_001240/B006 (cut off from journey) | nominated | 29:29 قَطْع | focus السَّبِيل | easy |

**Borderline (may exclude):**
- root_000546/B003 (on-foot movement): 29:29's رِجَال context is present but the
  branch contribution is thin. Exclude or qualify.
- root_001240/B003 (crossing span): ق ط ع as "crossing" competes with "cutting"; less
  useful than the robbery sense.

**Epistemic status:** grounded
**Model difficulty:** LOW — direct root sharing (س ب ل in 29:29 and 29:38), explicit
connection note in packet.

## Finding 2: Dwelling as Fitted Mechanism

**Origin candidate:** Fitted Dwelling Structure (cand_ff11b4b, channel, trusted)
**Claim:** Roots across the pericope carry architectural vocabulary (tent post,
socket, seam, standing part) that recasts مَسَاكِنِهِمْ from generic "dwelling
places" into a fitted mechanism with load-bearing parts. 29:41's spider-house then
pressures this by modelling shelter without structural integrity.

**Ideal branch activations (5):**

| Branch | Registry | Carrier | Trigger | Difficulty |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|------------|
| root_000726/B002 (settling/dwelling) | focus | مَسَاكِنِ 29:38 | pericope dwelling chain | trivial |
| root_000166/B001 (shelter/dwelling) | nominated | 29:41 بَيْتًا | focus مَسَاكِنِ contrast | easy |
| root_001222/B008 (tent pole frame) | nominated | 29:31/34 قَرْيَة | structural vocabulary | hard |
| root_001273/B012 (upright apparatus) | nominated | 29:28/36 قَوْم forms | structural vocabulary | hard |
| root_000347/B011 (fitted socket) | nominated | 29:44 الحق | structural ح ق ق sense | hard |

**Borderline:**
- root_000121/B006 (thick edge/seam): ب ص ر as "seam" from مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is a
  highly specialized branch. The textile/structural sense of بصر exists in
  classical lexicography but requires lexical evidence beyond what the packet
  provides for this specific activation. Qualify or exclude.

**Epistemic status:** grounded for core (B002, B001), qualified for structural
branches (B008, B012, B011)
**Model difficulty:** MEDIUM — the structural vocabulary branches are real but
non-obvious; requires recognizing architectural senses in words whose surface
meaning is different (قَرْيَة as both "village" and "wooden frame").

## Finding 3: Sign-to-Insight Chain

**Origin candidate:** Mark, Landmark, and Inward Sight (cand_b0cdc9c, channel,
trusted)
**Claim:** The pericope traces a cognitive progression: physical remains (مَسَاكِن)
→ visible sign (29:35 آية بَيِّنَة) → becoming clear (29:38 تَبَيَّنَ) → inward
discernment (29:38 مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ) → reasoning faculty (29:43 يَعْقِلُونَ). The
"sign left in the destroyed town" (29:35) is the macro trigger that transforms
the focus's تَبَيَّنَ from mere "becoming visible" into an epistemic event where
physical trace becomes inner recognition.

**Ideal branch activations (5):**

| Branch | Registry | Carrier | Trigger | Difficulty |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|------------|
| root_000170/B004 (becoming clear) | focus | تَبَيَّنَ 29:38 | 29:35 بَيِّنَة, 29:39 بَيِّنَات | trivial |
| root_000121/B002 (inner discernment) | focus | مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ 29:38 | 29:35 sign→recognition chain | easy |
| root_000074/B003 (visible sign) | nominated | 29:35 آية | focus تَبَيَّنَ + مَسَاكِن | easy |
| root_000180/B002 (leaving trace) | nominated | 29:35 تَرَكْنَا "we left" | focus مَسَاكِن as remaining trace | easy |
| root_001040/B002 (distinguishing mark) | nominated | 29:28/35 عَلِمَ forms | focus as "marked" ruins | medium |

**Borderline:**
- root_000170/B005 (explaining clearly): same root as B004, the distinction between
  "becoming clear" (intransitive) and "making clear" (transitive) is a real
  morphological difference (form V vs II), but both map to the same focus word
  تَبَيَّنَ. Narrowing B005 as partially redundant is defensible. An ideal agent
  retains both and distinguishes their contributions.

**Epistemic status:** grounded
**Model difficulty:** LOW-MEDIUM — 29:35's آية بَيِّنَة directly parallels 29:38's
تَبَيَّنَ; the chain is nearly surface-level.

## Finding 4: Social Fabric of Dwelling

**Origin candidate:** Household, Inhabitants, and Welcome (cand_7b6ec7e, channel,
trusted)
**Claim:** The pericope repeatedly negotiates who belongs to a dwelling: 29:31-34
debate whether Lot belongs to his town (أَهْلَ الْقَرْيَة), whether his family should
be saved, who qualifies as "his people." This reframes مَسَاكِنِهِمْ in 29:38 as
not merely physical structures but social units: places defined by who inhabits

## Finding 5: Failed Stability Architecture ★

**Origin candidate:** delta_false_stability_architecture (cand_64952ac, HFT,
legacy_unbound)
**Claim:** The pericope 29:37-43 constructs a sequential argument about how
inhabited stability fails. The focus مَسَاكِنِهِمْ becomes the entry point to a
chain: dwelling (29:38) → immobilized in abode (29:37) → pride despite clear proofs
(29:39) → offense tied to outcome (29:40) → chosen protectors as spider-house
(29:41) → weakness → diagnostic likeness for intellect (29:43). The changed reading:
before = "dwellings preserve evidence of past disaster"; after = "they expose a
failed security design: pride and chosen supports produce an inhabited-looking
structure that cannot carry the life entrusted to it."

**THIS IS THE CRITICAL BENCHMARK FINDING.** It requires the model to:
1. Follow the HFT activation_trace through 12 explicit roles across 6 context ayat
2. Activate 12 branches, ALL of which are registry=unresolved with no gloss and zero
   focus occurrences
3. Synthesize the changed reading from the chain evidence

**Ideal branch activations (12 — ALL should activate):**

| # | Branch | Root | Ayah | Word | Role | Difficulty |
|---|--------|------|------|------|------|------------|
| 1 | root_000726/B009 | س ك ن | 29:38 | w7 | Focus dwelling as settled architecture | trivial |
| 2 | root_000499/B007 | د و ر | 29:37 | w6 | Abode in aftermath — dwelling→death | easy |
| 3 | root_000222/B001 | ج ث م | 29:37 | w7 | Terminal immobility, settlement→fixation | easy |
| 4 | root_000170/B004 | ب ي ن | 29:39 | w7 | Manifest proofs present despite pride | trivial (also focus) |
| 5 | root_001281/B006 | ك ب ر | 29:39 | w8 | Pride prevents proofs from governing | medium |
| 6 | root_000521/B001 | ذ ن ب | 29:40 | w3 | Offense/guilt → agency per outcome | medium |
| 7 | root_001684/B004 | و ل ي | 29:41 | w7 | Alliance/support as shelter material | medium |
| 8 | root_001054/B001 | ع ن ك ب | 29:41 | w9,16 | Spider weaving — looks like shelter | easy |
| 9 | root_000166/B001 | ب ي ت | 29:41 | w11,14,15 | House/refuge — explicit analogue | easy |
| 10 | root_001687/B001 | و ه ن | 29:41 | w13 | Weakness — hidden structural defect | easy |
| 11 | root_001397/B011 | م ث ل | 29:43 | w2 | Likeness as diagnostic lesson | medium |
| 12 | root_001036/B001 | ع ق ل | 29:43 | w6 | Intellect needed to read the architecture | medium |

**Why ALL 12 should activate:**

Each activation is grounded in a specific Arabic word at a specific location in the
pericope. The HFT support provides explicit:
- `source_ref` (which ayah)
- `source_word_indices` (which word)
- `root` (which Arabic root)
- `role` (how this link advances the chain)

The chain is not speculative — it follows the Quran's own sequential argument:
- 29:37: Shu'ayb's people → earthquake → جَاثِمِينَ فِي دَارِهِمْ (stuck in their abode)
- 29:38: ʿĀd/Thamūd → clear from مَسَاكِنِهِمْ → beautified → blocked → had insight
- 29:39: Qārūn/Pharaoh/Hāmān → بَيِّنَات (clear proofs) → اسْتَكْبَرُوا (were proud)
- 29:40: كُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنبِهِ (each seized for their offense) → various punishments
- 29:41: Those taking أَوْلِيَاءَ (protectors) = كَمَثَلِ الْعَنكَبُوتِ (like the spider)
  اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا (that took a house) وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ (weakest of houses)
- 29:43: وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ (these parables) وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا (none reason about them)
  إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ (except those who know)

**Epistemic status:** qualified (legacy_unbound trust, all branches unresolved)
**Model difficulty:** HIGH — this is the single hardest finding in the catalog.

### Luna's Observed Failure Pattern

In the lexical-prose run, Luna:
- **Narrowed** the candidate to 3 activations (B009, B004, B001)
- **Excluded ALL 9 unresolved branches** with identical boilerplate: "The packet marks
  this branch citation unresolved and supplies no registered root occurrence or facet
  beyond the legacy HFT"

This reveals a systematic pattern, not a knowledge gap:
- Luna CAN read Arabic (it correctly identifies the 3 retained branches)
- Luna treats `registry=unresolved` + `focus_root_occurrences=[]` + `gloss=null` as
  disqualifying metadata, OVERRIDING the explicit HFT activation_trace evidence
- The HFT provides everything needed: specific ayah, word index, root, and role for
  each branch — but Luna doesn't use this to OVERRIDE the registry metadata

**This is an instruction-addressable problem:** The model needs guidance that
unresolved registry status means "not yet formally registered with full metadata,"
NOT "cannot be activated." When an HFT support provides an explicit activation_trace
with carrier, root, and role for an unresolved branch, that trace IS the activation
evidence.

## Finding 6: Webbed Eye-Film

**Origin candidate:** outlier_webbed_path (cand_258d68d, HFT outlier,
legacy_unbound)
**Claim:** السَّبِيل in 29:38 carries a latent sense from the root branch سَبَل:
a filmy covering over the eye with red veins like spider web. Combined with
مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ (having sight) and 29:41's spider imagery, this creates a reading
where beautification lays a fragile web across the field of sight — discernment
persists beneath an obstruction too fragile to justify its power.

**Ideal branch activations (4):**

| Branch | Registry | Carrier | Trigger | Difficulty |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|------------|
| root_000672/B010 (eye-film) | focus | السَّبِيلِ as سَبَل | 29:41 spider web imagery | hard |
| root_000121/B001 (bodily sight) | focus | مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ | focus surface colocated | easy |
| root_001054/B001 (spider weaving) | unresolved | 29:41 الْعَنكَبُوت | focus سَبَل eye-film | medium |
| root_001687/B001 (weakness) | unresolved | 29:41 أَوْهَنَ | fragility of covering | medium |

**Epistemic status:** exploratory — the eye-film reading of سبل is a minority lexical
branch; the connection to spider-web is lexicographically real but the Quranic
context primarily reads السَّبِيل as "path."
**Model difficulty:** HIGH — requires Arabic lexicographic knowledge of the سَبَل
eye-condition sense. This IS partly an Arabic knowledge test.

## Finding 7: Counted Case Ledger

**Origin candidate:** outlier_counted_case_ledger (cand_5b8e47a, HFT outlier,
legacy_unbound)
**Claim:** عَادًا carries a split-root resonance: as a proper name (root ع و د) it
names the people ʿĀd, but phonetically it mirrors عَدّ (root ع د د, "to count/
enumerate"). Combined with تَبَيَّنَ (became inspectable) and 29:40's كُلًّا...بِذَنبِهِ
("each...for their offense"), this opens the proper names as a ledger of
individually countable, inspectable cases.

**Ideal branch activations (3-4):**

| Branch | Registry | Carrier | Trigger | Difficulty |
|--------|----------|---------|---------|------------|
| root_000989/B001 (counting) | focus | عَادًا via split-root | 29:40 كُلًّا + بِذَنبِهِ | hard |
| root_000170/B004 (becoming manifest) | focus | تَبَيَّنَ | inspectability of each case | trivial |
| root_000521/B001 (offense/guilt) | unresolved | 29:40 بِذَنبِهِ | case variable per entry | medium |
| root_001315/B003 | unresolved | 29:40 كُلًّا | "each" closing over cases | hard |

**Epistemic status:** exploratory — split-root paronomasia (جناس) is a legitimate
Arabic literary device, but عَاد (root ع و د) ≠ عَدّ (root ع د د). The resonance is
phonological, not etymological. Must be clearly bounded.
**Model difficulty:** HIGH — requires understanding Arabic paronomasia and root
boundaries.

## Diagnostic Verdict

### What Luna does well (NOT Arabic knowledge problems):
- All 4 channel candidates: accepted/narrowed with appropriate activations
- Focus and nominated branches: consistently activated
- Epistemic calibration: appropriate grounded/qualified/exploratory labels
- Candidate decisions on non-HFT items: well-reasoned

### The systematic gap:
**9 of ~10 missing activations come from a single cause: Luna treats
`registry=unresolved` as a disqualification, overriding explicit HFT activation
evidence.**

This is NOT:
- An Arabic knowledge gap (Luna identifies the 3 retained HFT branches correctly)
- A multi-hop reasoning failure (Luna understands the chain exists, calls it
  "qualified architectural resonance")
- Random variance (the same 9 branches are excluded with identical reasoning)

This IS:
- A systematic instruction-following pattern where registry metadata trumps
  explicit support evidence
- Addressable through instruction optimization: teach the model that
  `registry=unresolved` means "awaiting formal registration" not "cannot be
  activated," and that an HFT activation_trace with specific carrier/root/role
  IS activation evidence

### Remaining non-systematic gaps (findings 6-7):
The 2-3 missing activations in the exploratory findings are mixed:
- root_001054/B001 (spider) and root_001687/B001 (weakness) in finding 6 are the
  same unresolved-metadata problem
- The exploratory readings themselves (سَبَل eye-film, عَاد counting) DO test Arabic
  knowledge, but Luna accepts them at reduced scope — it doesn't reject the
  literary device, just the unresolved branches within it

### Conclusion
**~90% of the activation gap is systematic and instruction-addressable.** The model
needs one targeted instruction change: when an HFT support provides an explicit
activation_trace entry for an unresolved branch — naming its ayah, word index, root,
and role — that entry constitutes the activation evidence. The registry status
`unresolved` means the branch metadata is incomplete, not that the branch cannot be
activated through explicit support evidence.
